implementation: Extends the existing pure detector and retains occurrence acknowledgement/clear semantics, observable/remediation fields, and legacy delivered-unacked-stale spelling. AnomalyWire borrows detector evidence and renders the frozen detail/evidence/relay shape.
STATUS_STALE_MS is 1800000; equality does not flag; waiting/hold/blocked/question suppress ordinary card drift. The existing 600000ms report stderr nudge is unchanged.

Open decisions project current parent, with current prime fallback for visibility only. Historical parent-at-ask remains in stored rows/opened events; reads do not write. Overdue decisions produce responsible-seat status-stale independently of fresh cards.

Dead-seat requires positive dead/recycled incarnation evidence and an actual matching seat.put seq. Probe failure is never converted to dead. Dispatch projection consumes the canonical dispatch event with action=delivered, not the fixture case id dispatch-delivered.

Question row and finalized decision.opened event commit atomically first. Existing semantic-state publication runs only after that bus operation returns. A second-step failure returns E-RS-QUESTION-PARTIAL with durable decision and seq.

Answers persist immutable outbound intent before existing DeliveryService.accept; self-answer has no push/msg id. Other-answer refusal leaves an open prepared row. Accepted closure plus decision.answered is atomic. Current parent is checked again inside the final publication boundary.

Verify authorizes only the current parent, selects the latest actual report.state done seq, and optionally checks an explicit assignment_id against task node and lifetime. Unscoped done never invents an assignment. Exact referenced done_seq controls anomaly closure.

GET here=<absolute-path>, POST --here from caller scope, seat filters, and real assignment.project filters are supported. Malformed scope errors carry the unscoped-status guidance; valid filtered views are not refused.
